The '''908th's HQ''' was the military headquarters of the [[908th Stormtrooper Division]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]]. A relatively small [[Planet/Legends|world]], Borosk's defenses included [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] ion minefields and planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], plus heavy planetary-defense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries, all of which surrounded the base.

In [[137 ABY]], the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]] out of [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], under the supervision of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maleval]], came to Borosk to eliminate the 908th Stormtrooper Division who had remained allied to Roan Fel. The ensuing [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|battle]] saw the elimination of the 908th as they tried to hold their base.
